text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Fest—a
large-scale event
held by Tracen
Academy to celebrate the fans.
Amid
the festivities, Inari One is...

text_block_list.name: Student Stall Runner
text_block_list.text:
Inari! We're running low on the yakisoba
sauce
quicker than we thought!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Okay! The okonomiyaki stall still has
plenty left,
so let's try our luck with
them! In the meantime,
get people
movin' on restock duty!

text_block_list.name: Student Stall Runner
text_block_list.text: Got it! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Student Stall Runner
text_block_list.text:
Inari! The chef making the carrot fried
rice is
about to pass out! Could we get a
little help?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Already on it! Just got in touch with the
student
council. We're gettin' some
extra help soon. Tell
her to hang in
there!

text_block_list.name: Student Stall Runner
text_block_list.text:
Wow, Inari! You're really the best in an

emergency!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One's been personally requested
by the
student council to manage the
food stalls, so I
offer to lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! It's so busy, my eyes are spinnin'! But a busy festival is a good festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sure is! But I shouldn't get ahead of
myself, not
when the crowd keeps
pourin' in.
choice_data_list: 今のところ順調そうだな
今のところ順調そうだね
choice_data_list_en: Things seem to be going smoothly so far.
Things seem to be going smoothly so far, don't they.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I heard most of 'em are visitin' just for
Oguri. This
year's shapin' up to be the
biggest one yet!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But that's how I like it! Can't have a
festival
without lotsa noise!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helpin' out, Boss! I know it's
tough
havin' ya on the clock since dawn.
Make sure to
get some rest if ya can!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for helpin' out, Boss! I know it's
tough
havin' ya on the clock since dawn.
Make sure to
get some rest if ya can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The festival is just as exciting as it is
busy, and as
the day progresses...

text_block_list.name: Visiting Fans
text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...The number of visitors continues to
climb!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yowza! This is wild! I honestly never expected this many people!

text_block_list.name: Student Stall Runner
text_block_list.text:
Inari, we're in trouble! If this keeps up,
we won't
be able to serve everyone!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're right, the stalls can't take this
many
visitors! We need to thin out the
crowd flow...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Management, can ya hear me?
Time to pull
out the trick we talked
about! Get some helpers
on the ground,
stat!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're lookin' at a gal raised on
festivals. I
learned a few things from my
hometown pals!

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
Inari One! We've mapped out the
diversion paths,
obtained the tools, and
stationed helpers out for
crowd safety.
Preparations should be ready soon!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gotta love our student council! Now it's
my time
to shine.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Attention, all visitors! I've got a special
event in
store for ya today!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Just beyond the food 'n' drink area, we're gonna be holdin' a mind-blowin' hashigo nori show! Come and have yourselves a look!

text_block_list.name: Female Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Did she say hashigo nori? As in ladder
acrobatics?
Wait, is she going to use
that big ladder over
there?!

text_block_list.name: Male Visitor
text_block_list.text: We should check it out!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Now that I've got a good crowd
gathered,
it's time to give 'em a show to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hup! Hah! Hwah!

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Whooooa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One puts on an amazing acrobatic

performance, drawing visitors away from
the food
stalls to see her!

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now that Inari One has the fans
distracted,
let's figure out a plan to
keep these stalls running!

text_block_list.name: Student Stall Runners
text_block_list.text: Got it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
There's more where that came from!
Feast your
eyes on this next trick!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woooow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One's stupendous stunts save the
day, and
the Fan Fest manages its
unprecedented visitor
count with no
problems!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later on, we decide to celebrate the
success in
my office.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Phew! Today really got me pooped!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, no kiddin'! There's a real master
of the stuff
back in my hometown. I
learned a whole bunch
there!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
We do the same thing to break up crowd
jams at
our local festivals. After
rememberin' that, I
figured I'd share the
strategy with the Fan Fest
crew.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
When ya supersize a festival, ya
supersize the
plannin'. Being sharp
means comin' up with a
whole slew of
things to please the guests!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! All that behind-the-scenes
work ya did
was just as cool! Well done
to the both of us!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! All that behind-the-scenes
work ya did
was just as cool! Well done
to the both of us!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While complimenting each other on our

respective efforts, we celebrate the
closing of a
festival well done.
